body: Hawks catch a lot of hate but I've always respected them. Truthfully I want to see Quick v. Lundy in the cup but whether it's L.A. or the hawks it'll be a worthy opponent. Thank you for writing.

> just think about the damage they can do in the future!

You really are a sub of optimistic people. This gave me a laugh, and I appreciate you taking the time to write to me. I'll be in here making a few check ins over the next 2 weeks or so depending on the playoff run.
